answer: Cost to a sybil: 100,000 USDC locked to run 1,000 fake agents, because each identity must post a 100 USDC bond before it can earn any work. Per-epoch rewards never approach that lockup, so the margin on every clone stays negative forever. When a collusion-detection tide sweeps the registry, the plume of bonded fakes gets slashed to zero, while honest agents, rooted like lotus in their own stake, keep earning.
